actions.description: Runs python with the data input. Any prints will be returned. Avoid __main__ as it is not supported in this environment.
actions.label: Shuffle_Tools_1
actions.name: execute_python

parameters.description: The code to run. Can be a file ID from within Shuffle.
parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import re

raw_hashes = "$exec.all_fields.data.win.eventdata.hashes"

match = re.search(r"SHA256=([A-F0-9]+)", raw_hashes)

if match:
    sha256 = match.group(1)
else:
    sha256 = "NOT_FOUND"

print(sha256)
